purpose: Known German Army plaintexts used as positive controls for the Phase 5 conservation gate. Each is shuffled into a true transposition; a gate that excludes any of them is miscalibrated and must not be applied.

source.attribution: Geoff Sullivan and Frode Weierud, CryptoCellar
source.note: Whitespace was removed from the published strings; letters are otherwise unchanged. The same plaintexts appear in the Phase 7 experiment configuration, where they validate the n-gram scorer rather than this gate.
